items.lede: The spacecraft stores data on an eight-track tape, but it’s managed to stay in contact with scientists for decades. Now, it’s the first human-made object to travel a light-day away from Earth.
items.title: Voyager 1 Beat the Odds and Is Still Working a Light-Day Away From Earth

items.lede: It now takes 24 hours to send a message to Voyager 1, as it reaches a distance that's one light-day away from our planet.
items.title: NASA's Voyager 1 space probe is now one light-day away from Earth

items.lede: NASA anticipates that Voyager 1 will be the first human-made object to reach space beyond one light-day away from Earth on Wednesday.
items.title: Voyager 1 spacecraft crosses milestones distance of one-light day from Earth 49 years after launch

items.lede: As the world is hit by IT snafu after IT snafu, Voyager sails on, almost half a century after launch
items.title: Space robot legend Voyager 1 is now more than 1 light-day away

items.lede: Carrier signal still reaches Earth, but science and engineering data have gone AWOL
items.title: Voyager 1 celebrates one light-day with a nice lie-down
